sources: Movement Disorder Society (MDS) Clinical Diagnostic Criteria (Postuma et al., 2015)
National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke (NINDS) Clinical Overview

symptoms.name: Resting Tremor
symptoms.description: Involuntary 4–6 Hz rhythmic oscillation occurring predominantly when muscles are at rest (often pill-rolling in fingers). Usually unilateral onset.
symptoms.source: MDS Clinical Diagnostic Criteria (Postuma et al., 2015)

symptoms.name: Bradykinesia
symptoms.description: Slowness of movement initiation and execution with progressive decrement in speed and amplitude during repetitive actions.
symptoms.source: MDS Clinical Diagnostic Criteria (Postuma et al., 2015)

symptoms.name: Cogwheel Rigidity
symptoms.description: Increased muscular stiffness and resistance to passive limb flexion, often feeling like a ratchet or cogwheel throughout movement.

symptoms.name: Hypophonia & Vocal Dysarthria
symptoms.description: Reduced vocal loudness, breathy tone, acoustic pitch tremor, increased jitter/shimmer, and monotone delivery from laryngeal rigidity.
symptoms.source: Sapir et al., Speech and Voice Disorders in Parkinson's

symptoms.name: Postural Instability
symptoms.description: Impaired balance, gait freezing, and reduced righting reflexes leading to falls, typically emerging in moderate-to-advanced stages.

symptoms.name: Micrographia
symptoms.description: Handwriting becomes cramped, tiny, and progressively smaller across lines due to basal ganglia motor sequence disruption.

symptoms.name: Hyposmia / Loss of Smell
symptoms.description: Reduced olfactory acuity that frequently precedes cardinal motor signs by 5 to 10 years due to early olfactory bulb Lewy pathology.
symptoms.source: Doty et al., Olfactory Dysfunction in Parkinson's

symptoms.name: REM Sleep Behavior Disorder (RBD)
symptoms.description: Loss of normal muscle atonia during REM sleep causing vivid dream enactment, vocalizing, or thrashing during sleep cycles.
symptoms.source: Iranzo et al., Neurobiology of RBD in Synucleinopathies

symptoms.name: Dysautonomia & Constipation
symptoms.description: Autonomic nervous system dysfunction affecting enteric nervous plexuses years prior to clinical motor diagnosis.
symptoms.source: Braak et al., Dual-hit Hypothesis of Parkinson Pathology

symptoms.name: Depression & Anxiety
symptoms.description: Neurochemical disruptions across dopamine, serotonin, and noradrenaline pathways manifesting as mood and motivational changes.
symptoms.source: Aarsland et al., Neuropsychiatric Symptoms in PD

symptoms.name: Cognitive Slowing (Bradyphrenia)
symptoms.description: Executive functioning changes, slowed information processing speed, and reduced multitasking or complex spatial navigation capacity.

symptoms.name: Dysphagia & Sialorrhea
symptoms.description: Coordination deficits across oropharyngeal swallowing phases causing coughing during meals, sialorrhea, and aspiration risks.
symptoms.source: Pflug et al., Swallowing Dysfunction in Parkinsonism
